items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I heard . . . you know Tavis Smiley?

ctx.x: Okay. So he wrote some music to include you with the quartet right? And you made those recordings which are I guess considered classics.
I even collected a few pennies [and] royalties over the years that he very generously awarded me. I heard . . . you know Tavis Smiley?
